learning_outcomes.text: Express and communicate ideas and systems related to thermodynamics.
Propose systems and carry out projects on basic energy installations.
Acquire knowledge in energy matters, which enables learning new methods and theories, and provides versatility to adapt to new situations.
Understand and prepare professional technical documentation, in the context of activities related to thermodynamics.

syllabus_topics: Energy and First Law of Thermodynamics
Thermodynamic Properties of Pure, Simple, and Compressible Substances
Practical 1: Use of RefProp for the calculation and handling of thermodynamic properties.
Practical 2: Visit to a power plant.
Practical 3: Visit to a refrigeration installation.

assessment_methods.method: Long and short answer tests, for continuous assessment - partial exam.
Long and short answer tests, for continuous assessment - ordinary exam.
Completion and submission of laboratory practicals.

assessment_rules: A minimum of 5 out of 10 points is required to pass the subject. The resit will consist of a long answer exam. Students taking the resit will not retain scores from the partial or ordinary exams. Only the score obtained from laboratory practicals will be retained for the resit.
bibliography: Moran M.J.; Shapiro H.N., Fundamentos de Termodinámica Técnica, Ed. Reverté, 2ª ed. Barcelona. 2011
Cengel A. Y.; Boles. A.M., Termodinámica, Ed. McGraw-Hill, 9ºed. México. 2019.
